glosses: by day, during the day, in the day, in the daytime

examples.en: The sun shines during the day.

examples.text: Ich schlafe tagsüber und arbeite nachts.
examples.en: I sleep during the day and work at night.

examples.text: Diese Straße war tagsüber sehr laut.
examples.en: That street was very noisy during the day.

examples.text: Lernen Sie lieber tagsüber oder nachts?
examples.en: Do you prefer to study during the day or at night?
